Use when shaping a new product or feature, capturing intent, producing a requirements/design spec, planning implementation, implementing from an approved plan, verifying work, reviewing changes, preparing deployment, or turning production findings into new intent. Follows the official Anthropic workflow of intent.md -> spec.md -> plan.md -> implementation/tests -> review -> deploy -> maintain.
